records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

No pressure, just a nudge: your workspace is still here whenever you're ready to pick it back up.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Pioneer Media
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, onboarding call held [calendar:8d7b7c1d] and welcome email sent [email:11537a97], yet no project, no invite, no key milestone and zero customer replies or tickets. Engagement exists (call attended) but no self-serve movement in 5 days since, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Pioneer Media's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Picking up where we left off: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
